about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Design with a clear point of view
paragraphs: I am currently a 7th-semester student pursuing a double degree in Information Systems and Management at Bina Nusantara University, class of 2027. With a strong interest in technology, business, and leadership, I aim to develop both my analytical and managerial skills to prepare for a future career that bridges IT and business strategy.

Alongside my academic journey, I am currently gaining professional experience as a Process Improvement and Reengineering Intern at Blibli. In this role, I am involved in identifying opportunities to improve business processes through process redesign, automation, and operational efficiency initiatives. This experience has strengthened my ability to analyze workflows, identify improvement opportunities, and develop practical solutions that can create measurable business impact.
about.subtitleId: Desain dengan sudut pandang yang jelas
paragraphsId: Saat ini, saya merupakan mahasiswa semester 7 yang sedang menempuh program double degree Information Systems dan Management di Bina Nusantara University, angkatan 2027. Dengan ketertarikan yang kuat pada bidang teknologi, bisnis, dan kepemimpinan, saya terus mengembangkan kemampuan analitis dan manajerial sebagai persiapan untuk membangun karier yang menghubungkan teknologi informasi dengan strategi bisnis.

Selain menjalani perkuliahan, saat ini saya juga memperoleh pengalaman profesional sebagai Process Improvement and Reengineering Intern di Blibli. Dalam peran ini, saya terlibat dalam mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan proses bisnis melalui perancangan ulang proses, otomatisasi, serta berbagai inisiatif peningkatan efisiensi operasional. Pengalaman ini membantu saya mengembangkan kemampuan dalam menganalisis alur kerja, menemukan peluang perbaikan, serta merancang solusi praktis yang dapat memberikan dampak bisnis yang terukur.

projects.title: EASE: Easing Anxiety Supporting Each
projects.challenge: The challenge in developing the EASE application was designing a cohesive experience for three different user roles, namely patients, doctors, and guardians, within a single platform that remains intuitive and easy to use. In addition, the team needed to ensure every design element felt empathetic rather than clinical, design a Panic Button mechanism that is quickly accessible yet not prone to accidental taps, and validate the CBT, ERP, and Somatic Experiencing therapy content so that it meets clinical standards while still being easy for lay users to understand.
projects.challengeId: Menyeimbangkan banyak pilihan menu dengan jalur cepat menuju pembelian yang meyakinkan.
projects.description: EASE is a digital mental health platform designed specifically to help individuals with anxiety disorders go through a holistic recovery process. Through the Three-Way Care approach, EASE integrates patients, doctors, and guardians into one care ecosystem connected in real time, ensuring that the healing process does not happen alone but is supported by a system that is supportive, inclusive, and free of stigma.
projects.descriptionId: Alur pemesanan yang jelas dan menarik untuk mengurangi hambatan dari pencarian hingga pembayaran.

projects.title: Portal KM Sukabumi Utara KM.03
projects.challenge: The main challenge is that residents' knowledge management is still informal, scattered across printed documents and chat groups, making it difficult to access and at risk of being lost (still at the socialization stage in the SECI model). Residents' less-than-optimal digital literacy calls for a simple interface, while a limited budget (IDR 7,000,000) and an implementation period of only four months demand efficiency from the team in designing, developing, and ensuring the portal's sustainability after the program ends.
projects.description: This project is the development of an AI-based Knowledge Management Portal for Karang Taruna RW 03 Sukabumi Utara, West Jakarta. The portal serves as a centralized platform for activity documentation, UMKM (small business) guides, training materials, and administrative services (introduction letters, domicile letters), equipped with an NLP chatbot, a recommendation system, automatic classification, and an analytics dashboard. Development covered activity diagrams, use case diagrams, wireframes, and a high-fidelity Figma prototype for both residents and admins, achieving a usability testing score of 4.42/5 (Very Good) from 50 respondents.

projects.title: Klinik Pratama Sarana Sehat Sejahtera
projects.challenge: The challenge in developing the Management Information System for Klinik Pratama Sarana Sehat Sejahtera was integrating all of the clinic's operational processes, which had previously been carried out manually, into a single comprehensive and efficient digital system. Processes such as creating appointments, recording medical records, calculating doctor commissions, and generating monthly reports, which had been handled separately and manually, needed to be redesigned into a structured and interconnected system flow. In addition, the team also needed to ensure the system could accommodate the needs of the various actors involved, from patients, doctors, therapists, receptionists, and admins to the clinic owner, within a single platform that remained easy for all parties to use.
projects.description: The Management Information System for Klinik Pratama Sarana Sehat Sejahtera is a web-based application designed to digitalize the operational processes of a clinic focused on bioresonance therapy services. This system covers four main modules: appointment management, a health forum and articles, automatic doctor commission calculation, and monthly clinic operational reports, developed up to the prototype stage, including requirements analysis, UML design, ERD, wireframes, and a high-fidelity prototype.

projects.title: SahabatSehat
projects.challenge: One of the main challenges in developing the SahabatSehat application was designing an interface that was genuinely easy to use for elderly users with low digital literacy. In addition, the team also faced difficulties in simplifying fairly complex health features so they remained informative without being confusing for older users.
projects.description: The SahabatSehat project is a mobile health-monitoring application designed specifically for the elderly using a User-Centered Design approach, so that its interface and features are easy for older users to operate. The application helps elderly users monitor their health through features such as medication reminders, health condition logging, physical activity monitoring, and meal planning, enabling them to maintain their health independently.

projects.title: SkillFuel
projects.challenge: The challenge in developing SkillFuel lies in the large skill gap between users and industry needs, users' limited practical experience and portfolios, and the difficulty of determining the right career path. In addition, the large number of course options leaves users feeling confused, while on the company side, the candidate screening process remains inefficient due to many irrelevant CVs and the difficulty of accurately validating candidates' abilities.
projects.description: SkillFuel is an AI-based career development platform that helps fresh graduates and young professionals improve their job readiness through an integrated ecosystem. The platform provides features such as an AI CV Generator, Skill Gap Analysis, project simulations, courses, mentoring, and Smart Recruiter Matching. With these features, users can build skills and portfolios and effectively obtain job opportunities that match industry needs.

projects.title: Szān
projects.challenge: The main challenge in developing the Szān application was designing a system capable of displaying unique and varied products without making the user experience overly complicated. In addition, it was necessary to ensure that the product catalog process, the management of limited stock, and features such as the mystery box could run smoothly within the system. Another challenge was creating a simple and easy-to-use interface so that users could quickly find the products they were looking for.
projects.description: Szān is an online clothing store built around the concept of sustainable fashion, transforming sterilized secondhand clothing into new garments with unique designs. Each product is made from a combination of several materials, resulting in different patterns so that no two pieces of clothing are exactly alike. Besides selling various upcycled clothing items, Szān also offers products such as mystery boxes to provide a more engaging shopping experience for customers.

projects.title: Travio
projects.challenge: The challenge in the Travio project was designing a system capable of integrating various travel services into a single unified platform. From this project, one can learn how to understand user needs, design business flows, create various system diagrams, and design the data structure and application interface so that all features can run in an integrated, clear manner and be easy for users to use.
projects.description: Travio is a mobile application that helps users plan trips more easily. Through this application, users can search for and book travel needs such as hotels, tickets for entertainment venues, vehicle rentals, and the Local Buddy service, which acts as a local guide. Travio also provides information on prices, facilities, service availability, and user reviews to support decision-making, making trips more practical and organized.

projects.title: SiTiket
projects.challenge: The challenge in developing this project was building the integration between the JavaFX user interface and the database system so that data could be displayed and stored correctly. In addition, the developers also needed to manage the navigation flow between pages, organize the desktop application's code structure, and ensure the UI remained simple while still being easy for users to use.
projects.description: Sitiket is a desktop application project developed using the Java programming language. The application features a simple user interface built with JavaFX to make it easy for users to view information and make ticket bookings. In addition, the application is integrated with a database used to store user data, ticket data, and booking transactions in a structured manner.

projects.title: FloraArtistry
projects.challenge: The challenge in developing the FloraArtistry project was integrating the JavaFX interface with the MySQL database so that user data, flower products, and transactions could be managed consistently. In addition, the developers needed to build input validation for the login, registration, and product management processes, as well as set up the navigation flow between the admin and customer pages so that the application would run properly.
projects.description: FloraArtistry is a desktop application project developed using the Java programming language to help manage a flower shop. The application features a simple user interface built with JavaFX and is connected to a MySQL database to store user data, flower products, shopping cart items, and purchase transactions in a structured manner.

projects.title: Domus Group
projects.challenge: The challenge in developing the DOMUS Group database project was designing a database structure capable of integrating various business processes such as procurement, raw material stock management, suppliers, and sales transactions without causing data redundancy. In addition, proper design of relationships between entities was needed to keep data consistent, accurate, and able to efficiently support the company's operational processes.
projects.description: Project database DOMUS Group is the design of a database system to support the procurement and sales business processes of a furniture company. This system is designed to reduce data redundancy, integrate the recording of stock, suppliers, transactions, and invoices, and improve data management efficiency through an organized database structure that supports business operations more accurately.

projects.title: NovaScript Academy
projects.challenge: The main challenge in developing NovaScript Academy was designing a validation system for the registration process to ensure that the user data entered remained valid and secure. Validation was implemented to make sure inputs such as name, email, password, and password confirmation were filled in correctly and in accordance with the specified format. This process uses JavaScript for client-side validation and PHP for further checks on the server side.
projects.description: NovaScript Academy is a coding learning website developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP. This platform is designed to help beginners learn the fundamentals of programming through structured video tutorials. The material currently available covers HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The website is also designed to be further expanded with additional learning features in the future.

projects.title: My Portfolio
projects.challenge: The main challenge in developing this portfolio website was designing a look that is simple yet still attractive and professional. In addition, careful layout, animation, and responsive navigation were needed so that each section, such as projects, certificates, and contact, could be displayed neatly and be easily accessible to visitors.
projects.description: This portfolio website showcases my profile, experience, and various projects I have worked on in the fields of technology and product development. Built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, the website is designed with a modern and responsive look. Each project includes a description, documentation, and a source code link to demonstrate the development process and the technical skills I possess.
